{{Short description|City in Ukhdari}}

'''Tardakal''' is a city in [[Ukhdari]] in central [[Ayuma]]. It was one of nine cities selected as a host city for the [[1760 FLLA World Cup]].

Tardakal Stadium, a 43,200-seat venue, was the smallest of the ten stadiums used at the tournament. It staged six group-stage matches at the 1760 World Cup, all of them on the lower attendance tier, although none fell below the [[FLLA]] minimum of 40,000 seats for World Cup use.
